title: Executive at Professional Services Firm Expects Databricks Business to Grow 30% in 2026
expert: Senior leader, professional services firm serving enterprise and upper mid-market clients ($1B-$50B+ revenue; current)
verdict: This services firm's Databricks business grew ~30% y/y in Aug-Oct, 10%-15% above plan, with ~90% renewals and deal sizes up ~15%-20%, though effective pricing is flat to down up to 5% as Databricks answers Snowflake discounting.

Demand / orders: 🟢 **Databricks business +~30% y/y (Aug-Oct), 10%-15% above plan**; vs +24%-26% at a global SI and +30%, 35%-40% commercial at a reseller (2026-11-05 calls): **consistent**. → Thesis (re-acceleration) ↑ [20 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270248&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse8281&hl=fse8281,fse8628,fse8685,fse8917,fse9129,fse9169&page=2)

🟢 **~90% renewals; deal sizes +~15%-20%** vs +25%-30% at a global SI (2026-11-05): consistent, slightly smaller. → Thesis (re-acceleration) ↑ [21 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270248&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse9984&hl=fse9984,fse10277,fse10368&page=2)

🟢 **Genie live at 20% or more of customers, adoption +~30%-40% q/q (estimate)** vs under 5% at a global SI (2026-11-05): **higher**. → Thesis (Agent Bricks/AI) ↑ [24 • Expert Call](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-270248&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse18665&hl=fse18665,fse18954,fse19009&page=2)

changes: Business +~30% y/y vs +24%-26% Q3 practice growth at a global SI (2026-11-05 call): consistent to slightly higher.
Deal sizes +~15%-20% vs +25%-30% (2026-11-05 SI) and +about 15%-20% (2026-11-05 reseller): consistent.
Effective pricing flat to down up to 5% vs 12%-14% (Lakebase/SQL) and 4%-6% (newer products) increases at a global SI (2026-11-05): conflicting.
Genie live at 20% or more of customers vs under 5% (2026-11-05 SI) and about 20% of commercial customers (2026-11-05 reseller): higher.
thesis_impact: No tenets on the Databricks Thesis page; measured against its thesis bullets (2025-09-10).
Thesis (run-rate re-acceleration): ↑ — partner business +~30% with ~90% renewals; pricing flat to down up to 5% caps the upside.
Thesis (Agent Bricks/AI): ↑ — AI is 30%-40% of the next 3-6 month pipeline (estimate); Genie adoption +~30%-40% q/q.
Thesis (multi-cloud/open): ↑ — winning more vs cloud-native analytics on open formats.
